description: This file is a Python script for a plugin skeleton generator, involving user prompts, configuration parsing, interface parsing, and code generation coordination.

methods.name: loadYAML
methods.description: Loads a YAML configuration file, handling errors if file does not exist or parsing fails.

methods.name: validatePaths
methods.description: Checks if provided file paths exist, exits if any are missing.

methods.name: collectList
methods.description: Collects multiple string entries from user input until an empty line is entered.

methods.name: prompts
methods.description: Prompts user for plugin configuration details including name, process type, header files, and subsystems.

methods.name: parserInterfaces
methods.description: Parses header files to extract interface class data using MultiParser.

methods.name: displayParsedData
methods.description: Displays parsed interface data in a formatted manner.

methods.name: _root
methods.description: Extracts the root name from a fully qualified interface name.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Main function that handles command-line arguments, loads or prompts configuration, parses interfaces, and initiates code generation.
